# A question's own chunk listed as an answer key, schema v16

Unedited live replies of the one-family-per-batch run d26-real-1fam-low-19 on
svenska_2_kursavslutande_prov_med_facit. Reply `docx_w2-09-01` lists body:0086 both in
`answer_key_anchors` and in the source_anchors of the item for the question the grouping
gives body:0085 and body:0086 as its own chunks.

The same item has kind gap_fill and no gap: it prints the facit for its a) and b) lines as plain
text. The native contract therefore turns it into a review item whether or not body:0086 is an
answer key.
